name: Climax Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Climax Technology Co. Ltd. develops, manufactures, and distributes wireless security systems in the American, European, and Japanese markets. The company's products include wireless alarm systems, wired alarm systems, telecare, IoT accessories, ZigBee accessories, Z-wave accessories, DECT ULE accessories, security cameras, and video doorphones. It serves home, family, and healthcare facilities. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
